Sister DevOpsPink is taking confessions 😈

My Halloween video: the 7 deadly sins of AI agents, and how to fix each one.

🍔 Gluttony: no "done", no budget
💋 Lust: too many tools
👑 Pride: prompts without review
🦥 Sloth: agents waiting forever
💰 Greed: one shared bill
💚 Envy: an agent for a one-line task
😡 Wrath: retries without backoff
👻 Bonus: ghost agents still running

Based on the AWS Well-Architected Agentic AI Lens.

https://youtu.be/8Q8MznholaA

#AIAgents #AgenticAI #Halloween #DevOps #LLM
